Real Feel Food Access - Environmental factors like heat and tree shade impact the ability of people to traverse distances to resources. Integrate this impact into food access/desert maps. Hyperlocal climate-aware, spatiotemporally dynamic calculation of de facto food access among urban residents
Tags: Geospatial Web-Application Green-Infrastructure Trees Citizen-Science Community-Engagement
Arboreta in the Parks - A geospatial web application to help Chicago Park District Park Stewards attain and maintain arboretum status at their park. It tracks progress towards identification of 25 unique tree types as necessary to apply for arboretum status and maintenance of these trees in good conditions, and provides a publicly available map of park trees by type.
Tags: Desktop-Application Data-Sharing Data-Packaging Metadata Open-Data
Originally developed (in close collaboration with researchers) to facilitate FAIR data sharing by researchers spanning the wide range of research communities funded by the The National Institutes of Health Helping to End Addiction Long-term (HEAL) Initiative®, using the HEAL Data Package Framework and Tool to package data is easy, and results in high quality “Dataverse-ready” data packages, with structured metadata that makes data package review and re-use easier, and automatable.
HEAL Data Package Framework - Detailed data packaging specifications and user-friendly web documentation
HEAL Data Package Tool - Desktop tool that provides a user-friendly interface to operationalize data packaging and curation compliant with HEAL Data Package Framework specifications

title: Contact
Services
text: Rooted Data provides technical consulting and analytical development across two primary service areas:

title: Services
text:
1. Data Strategy, Infrastructure & Governance
Clear data processes reduce operational risk and increase trust. I design and implement data systems where transparency and standards are built-in from the start.

Reproducible Data Pipelines: Developing end-to-end data processing workflows that are fully auditable, automated, and documented.
Data Governance & Understandability: Creating standards that make data accessible and interpretable for both technical developers and non-technical stakeholders.
Automated Quality Controls: Setting up tools and continuous integration checks that enforce data validation and coding standards automatically.

title: Services
text:
2. Geospatial Science & Urban Analytics
Bridging the gap between spatial data, urban planning, and community outcomes.

Spatial Analysis & Tooling: Building specialized Python and R packages, custom web-mapping utilities, and spatial processing workflows.
Urban & Public Health Analytics: Combining demographic, environmental, and health datasets to understand geographic trends and disparities.
Data Communication & Public Engagement: Translating technical spatial findings into clear dashboards, visual reports, and public-facing interfaces.

title: Rooted Data
text:
Core Capabilities


🗺️ Mapping & Urban Analytics
Advanced spatial modeling, GIS analysis, and urban informatics to uncover geographic patterns and inform equitable planning decisions.


🔒 Data Governance & Sharing
Building ethical data governance frameworks, data-sharing protocols, and privacy-preserving pipelines for inter-agency collaboration.


🛠️ Software & Web App Tools
Custom open-source tools, interactive dashboards, and web applications built to make complex data accessible and actionable.


🤝 Community Engagement
Designing participatory data workflows, community-led data collection, and inclusive reporting that center local voices.

title: Services & Expertise
text: At Rooted Data, technical analytical rigor meets deep context awareness. Every project is tailored to ensure data serves both organizational goals and the broader public good.

title: Services & Expertise
text:
What We Do

1. Urban Analytics & Spatial Science
We combine geospatial analysis with data science to model urban systems, environmental patterns, and demographic shifts. * Custom GIS workflows & spatial data pipelines * Spatial statistics & predictive land-use modeling * Interactive web maps and spatial dashboards


2. Data Governance & Responsible Sharing
Data is most valuable when shared safely and ethically. We help organizations build trust and infrastructure around sensitive datasets. * Data governance framework development * Secure inter-organizational data sharing agreements * Ethical data risk assessments and privacy protection


3. Custom Software & Interactive Tools
When off-the-shelf software falls short, we design custom analytical tools and web interfaces tailored to your team’s workflow. * Web applications (R Shiny, Python Streamlit, React/Mapbox) * Open-source data pipelines and R/Python packages * Automated reporting systems


4. Community-Centered Engagement
Data should empower communities, not alienate them. We facilitate collaborative research and participatory data design. * Participatory mapping & community co-design workshops * Accessible data storytelling and public report design * Community data literacy training
